### AAO Renewal Forecast

<details><summary>Power Query (M), redacted</summary>

```m
let
    Source = #"AAO Renewals",
    #"Appended Query" = Table.Combine({Source, #"AAO New"}),
    #"Removed Columns" = Table.RemoveColumns(#"Appended Query",{"Name"}),
    #"Sorted Rows" = Table.Sort(#"Removed Columns",{{"Date", Order.Ascending}}),

RenewalRate = 0.70,                 
TermYears   = 3,                     
HorizonEnd  = Date.EndOfMonth(Date.AddMonths(Date.From(DateTime.LocalNow()), 24)),
DistTable =
    #table(type table [Offset = Int64.Type, Weight = number],
           { {-1, 0.20}, {0, 0.60}, {1, 0.20} }),

Base =
    #"Sorted Rows",         

Typed =
    Table.TransformColumnTypes(Base, {{"Date", type date}}),

WithExpiry =
    Table.AddColumn(Typed, "Expiry", each Date.AddYears([Date], TermYears), type date),

AddSpread =
    Table.AddColumn(WithExpiry, "Spread",
        (r as record) =>
            List.Transform(Table.ToRecords(DistTable),
                (d as record) => [
                    Month            = Date.StartOfMonth(Date.AddMonths(r[Expiry], d[Offset])),
                    ExpectedRenewals = RenewalRate * d[Weight]
                ])),
Explode  = Table.ExpandListColumn(AddSpread, "Spread"),
Expanded = Table.ExpandRecordColumn(Explode, "Spread",
            {"Month","ExpectedRenewals"},
            {"Month","Expected Renewals"}),

ThisMonthStart = Date.StartOfMonth(Date.From(DateTime.LocalNow())),
Future =
    Table.SelectRows(Expanded, each [Month] >= ThisMonthStart and [Month] <= HorizonEnd),

Monthly =
    Table.Group(Future, {"Month"},
        {{"Forecast Renewals", each List.Sum([Expected Renewals]), type number}}),

RenewalForecast =
    Table.TransformColumns(Monthly, {{"Forecast Renewals", each Number.Round(_, 3), type number}})
in
RenewalForecast
```

let
    Source    = #"AAO Renewals",
    Typed     = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Source, {{"Date", type date}}),
    NoNulls   = Table.SelectRows(Typed, each [Date] <> null),
    AddMonth  = Table.AddColumn(NoNulls, "Month", each Date.StartOfMonth([Date]), type date),
    Grouped   = Table.Group(AddMonth, {"Month"}, {{"Total", each Table.RowCount(_), Int64.Type}}),

    // Build full Month list from min to max
    MinMonth  = Date.StartOfMonth(List.Min(AddMonth[Month])),
    MaxMonth  = Date.StartOfMonth(List.Max(AddMonth[Month])),
    MonthList = List.Generate(() => MinMonth, each _ <= MaxMonth, each Date.AddMonths(_, 1)),
    AllMonths = Table.FromList(MonthList, Splitter.SplitByNothing(), {"AllMonths"}),

    // Left join by renaming one column to avoid duplication
    Joined    = Table.NestedJoin(AllMonths, {"AllMonths"}, Grouped, {"Month"}, "GroupedData", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
    Expanded  = Table.ExpandTableColumn(Joined, "GroupedData", {"Month", "Total"}, {"Month", "Total"}),

    // Fill nulls with zero
    Cleaned   = Table.ReplaceValue(Expanded, null, 0, Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"Total"}),
    Sorted    = Table.Sort(Cleaned, {{"AllMonths", Order.Ascending}}),
    #"Removed Columns" = Table.RemoveColumns(Sorted,{"Month"}),
    #"Renamed Columns" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Removed Columns",{{"AllMonths", "Month"}}),
    #"Changed Type" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Renamed Columns",{{"Month", type date}})
in
    #"Changed Type"

### Query1

**Source:** Power Query calculation (refresh timestamp)

<details><summary>Power Query (M), redacted</summary>

```m
let
    // Get current UTC time
    nowUtc = DateTimeZone.FixedUtcNow(),
    
    // Get a candidate local time assuming standard NZ time (UTC+12)
    localCandidate = DateTimeZone.SwitchZone(nowUtc, 12),
    localDate = DateTime.Date(localCandidate),
    currentYear = Date.Year(localDate),
    currentMonth = Date.Month(localDate),
    
    // Determine if DST is in effect.
    // New Zealand DST is in effect from the last Sunday in September until the first Sunday in April.
    // For dates in April or September, we check the specific boundary date.
    isDST =
        if currentMonth = 4 then
            // For April, calculate the first Sunday of April.
            let
                april1 = #date(currentYear, 4, 1),
                firstSundayApril = if Date.DayOfWeek(april1, Day.Sunday) = 0 
                     then april1 
                     else Date.AddDays(april1, 7 - Date.DayOfWeek(april1, Day.Sunday))
            in
                // If today is before the first Sunday, it's still DST.
                localDate < firstSundayApril
        else if currentMonth = 9 then
            // For September, calculate the last Sunday of September.
            let
                sept30 = #date(currentYear, 9, 30),
                lastSundaySept = Date.AddDays(sept30, -Date.DayOfWeek(sept30, Day.Sunday))
            in
                // If today is on or after the last Sunday, DST is active.
                localDate >= lastSundaySept
        else if currentMonth < 4 then
            // January to March are in DST.
            true
        else if currentMonth > 9 then
            // October to December are in DST.
            true
        else
            // May, June, July, August are standard time.
            false,
    
    // Choose the correct offset
    offset = if isDST then 13 else 12,
    
    // Convert UTC to Wellington local time using the calculated offset.
    localTime = DateTimeZone.SwitchZone(nowUtc, offset)
in
    localTime
```

</details>

                         otherwise try Date.FromText(Text.From(v), "en-NZ")
                         otherwise try Date.FromText(Text.From(v), "en-US")
                         otherwise try Date.From(Number.From(v))

    LastActualMonth = List.Max(#"Sorted Rows"[Month]),

    Last6Months = Table.LastN(#"Sorted Rows", 6),

    ),

    ),

        #"Added Forecast Flag"
    }),

    #"Final Sorted Rows" = Table.Sort(

        {{"Month", Order.Ascending}}
    )
in
